title: Keystone primitive frontmatter (5.0)
description: YAML frontmatter of a charter primitive under .agents/. The kind is inferred from the directory (rules/, references/, hooks/, permissions/, evals/, skills/, commands/, agents/, tools/, documents/), so `kind:` is optional. Constraints: rule, reference, hook, permission, eval. Capabilities: skill, command, subagent, tool, document. Validate a file against `#/$defs/<kind>`, picked by its directory (frontmatter alone cannot tell kinds apart). See ADR 0010. 4.x spellings stay readable: kinds guide/corpus/sensor/posture/agent/playbook/pattern, `globs:` for `paths:`, `on:` for `event:`.

id.description: Stable id; defaults to the path slug. Characters: [a-z0-9-:_/].

description.description: One line. Agents use it to decide whether to open the body.

corpus.description: References (the why) this primitive cites; loaded on demand.

deps.description: Retired in 3.0; read for back-compat only.

rule.description: Constraint. An ambient directive, scoped by paths. Lives at .agents/rules/<topic>/<name>.md.

paths.description: Globs this rule governs. The key Claude Code and Cline read. Absent = always on.

mode.description: computational rules fire `run:` (an LSP or formatter); inferential rules are read by the agent.

reference.description: Constraint (keystone extension). The reasoning behind a rule, loaded on demand. Lives at .agents/references/<topic>/<name>.md.

hook.description: Constraint. A check that reacts to a host event or a signal and gates on its verdict. Lives at .agents/hooks/<id>.md.

event.description: A host event (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, …) or a signal (pre-verify, on-gate, or a custom name).

run.description: Shell command; required when computational. Non-zero exit blocks.

permission.description: Constraint. Tool permission rules in Claude Code syntax (`Tool` or `Tool(specifier)`). Deny wins. Lives at .agents/permissions/<id>.md.

eval.description: Constraint (keystone extension). A fixture-based test of whether the charter changes agent behavior. Lives at .agents/evals/<id>/EVAL.md.

skill.description: Capability. An Agent Skills spec SKILL.md (https://agentskills.io/specification) at .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md. Only spec keys are allowed; `keystone lint --fix` converts the 4.x shape.

description.description: What the skill does and when to use it — the activation contract.

allowed-tools.description: Space-separated tool names. Experimental in the spec.

metadata.description: String to string. Keystone reads `model` and `tags` (comma-separated) from here.

command.description: Capability. A user-invoked unit of work. Lives at .agents/commands/<id>.md.

subagent.description: Capability. A role the main agent delegates to. Lives at .agents/agents/<id>.md, the directory hosts read.

tool.description: Capability. An author-defined callable, served by the keystone MCP server. Lives at .agents/tools/<id>.md.

event.description: Optional: fire as a side-effect on this event or signal.

document.description: Capability (keystone extension). A governed output template (ADR, review, retro, …). Instances live under .keystone/work/. Lives at .agents/documents/<id>.md.
